title: Finite-family estimator program with samples
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $m$ be a natural number. The random-example learning program draws $m$ independent uniform labeled examples for each member of $\mathcal F$, applies the labeled finite-family Fourier estimator to the resulting matrix, and charges $|\mathcal F|m(n+1)$ units of local work.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
